name: Mimori Mamori
source:
Likes: [url=/c62611]Gozen Reiji, Misaki Reiji, Ree-kun[/url]
Skill: blogging
Role: Gozen Reiji's stalker

A university student who attends the same Toushou University as Reiji. She is a stalker girl who is convinced that she is Reiji's lover and pops up to play girlfriend wherever he goes. She calls him "Ree-kun" and always carries around a plushie whose clothes modeled after his. Her actions are unpredictable and come out of nowhere. She is quite clumsy even though she doesn't realize it herself.

[Translated from [url=http://5pb.jp/games/j7/]the official site[/url]]
